_help: Category-page FAQs whose QUESTION matches one of these patterns are left out, because order-specific topics (delivery dates, tracking, order status, cancelling, changing an order) are handled by Engaige policies such as WISMO. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions, grouped per language. The 'en' patterns are always applied too, because some non-English pages still contain English FAQs. Every FAQ that is left out is listed in the build report.
